description: Have qed.bot rebuild a Lean file at its commit and read what every theorem in it depends on, under the admission rules every stranger's file is held to. Free: each account may start 10 public and 3 private checks a day. Make an API key at https://qed.bot/check and send it as Authorization: Bearer qed_.... Returns at once with the check queued; call get_check until it is done, which takes minutes. A file already checked in public is returned without counting against the allowance.

private.description: Only you can see the result

theorem.description: The theorem it proves, which must be declared

url.description: GitHub blob URL of the .lean file, at a full commit

name: check_proof
